prototype: RustPython0.4 trusted CPython3.13 standard-library compiler with Rust SRE matcher and source-pinned Unicode15.1 tables
remaining_gates: Prototype evaluates trusted CPython standard-library compiler source in a Rust interpreter; no CPython runtime is used, but this is not a pure-Rust compiler implementation and is not selected for the migration.
A production Rust supervisor and request protocol are absent; the external deadline/address-space tests use a Python test harness.
Exhaustive named-character algorithm variants, Unicode identifier handling and broader engine edge cases still need comparison.
Reproducible packaging, licenses/provenance, combined filter-policy tests and real refresh-job resource evidence are required before selection.
notes: The original unmodified fancy-regex candidate remains rejected with50of154differences; this prototype does not replace that report.
Two hostile backtracking cases terminate as failed worker requests; timeout/kill is never treated as a negative regex match.
Input pattern/text/message caps are explicit; no public refresh endpoint uses this prototype.
Original Dispatcharr authors retain full application credit; compiler/engine/library copyrights belong to CPython, SecretLabs and RustPython contributors.
